title: PCSO Nov. 23 lotto results: No winners for P80.13M jackpots

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket holder won the Grand Lotto 6/55 and Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpots totaling P80.13 million in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Monday, Nov. 23, 2026. According to PCSO results, the Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 34-48-04-49-22-08, with a jackpot of P45 million. No bettor matched
